name: Varoulko Seaside
neighborhood: Mikrolimano · Akti Koumoundourou boardwalk
recognition: Athinorama Greek Cuisine Awards 2026 (11 May 2026): 16/20, top Greek-cuisine restaurant in the country. MICHELIN: in the 2024 Greece selection without a Star (lost in 2024); the 2026/27 selection is due 20 Oct 2026
what_to_order: Bakaliaros me skordalia|Grilled cuttlefish, caramelised lentils, orange|Red-shrimp tartare, basil & ouzo|Sea urchin|Seafood tasting menu|Assyrtiko, Santorini
best_time: Sunset tasting menu
notes: FLAG: no current Michelin star (lost in the 2023 Greece-guide relaunch) — confirm at booking; Lazarou b.1952 still chef-patron; the Seaside room moved to the Mikrolimano boardwalk in 2013; book the sunset tasting menu.
verdict: The most ambitious cooking of the Greek sea in Piraeus — restrained, precise, modern Aegean plating on the Mikrolimano water, a genuine fine-dining room dropped among the fish tavernas.
caveat: Not a taverna and not for a spontaneous cheap lunch — book ahead and expect fine-dining prices.

name: Dourabeis
neighborhood: Mikrolimano · Akti Dilaveri, below Kastella
tier: THE BERTHS · MIKROLIMANO — THE NAMED HOUSES
recognition: LiFO 2023 — two-Michelin-star chef Alex Atala (D.O.M., São Paulo) chose Dourabeis on his Athens visit
what_to_order: Marinated crawfish (astakouri)|Salata Dourabeis|Salt-grilled fresh fish|Linguine with oysters|Red-snapper ceviche|Shrimp saganaki
best_time: Weekend water-side lunch
notes: FLAG: fresh fish by the kilo — the bill climbs fast; sits on the quieter Akti Dilaveri arm, not the tout horseshoe; two-Michelin-star Alex Atala ate here in 2023; verify the weekly closing day by phone.
verdict: Piraeus's benchmark old-guard fish house since 1932 — impeccable raw shellfish and salt-grilling at their most exacting, the standard every other harbour table is judged against.
caveat: Not for a cheap taverna night — refined, dressed-up and priced like the institution it is; by-the-kilo bills climb fast.
hot_this_month: Trawl fish are back since 1 October 2026: this is the season for a salt-grilled sinagrida or fangri rather than farmed bream; weekend lunch, book (checked 14 Oct 2026).

name: Papaioannou
neighborhood: Mikrolimano · Akti Koumoundourou waterfront
recognition: Athinorama Greek Cuisine Awards 2026 (11 May 2026): 14.5/20 for Papaioannou Mikrolimano, alongside the Kavouri and Kefalari branches
what_to_order: Charcoal-grilled whole fish|Astakomakaronada|Sea-urchin salad|Marinated anchovies (gavros)|Grilled octopus|Assyrtiko white
best_time: Sunset, white linen
notes: FLAG: fish by the kilo, ~€70–100pp — not a quick bite; prime waterfront corner of the horseshoe; chef Giorgos still picks the catch at the market at dawn; part of the Okyalos group; book for a sunset table.
verdict: The one Mikrolimano waterfront table worth the splurge — minimalist, ultra-fresh catch cooked with restraint and respect.
caveat: Not cheap and not casual — fish is by the kilo and the bill climbs; not the place for a quick bite.

name: Margaro
neighborhood: Hatzikyriakio · beside the Hellenic Naval Academy
address: Leof. Chatzikyriakou 126 & Ath. Miaouli, Hatzikyriakio, 185 39 Piraeus
recognition: Athinorama 2024 — 'a tiganitzidiko with 80 years of history'; in the official This Is Athens seafood-in-Piraeus guide
what_to_order: Garides tiganites (fried shrimp)|Koutsomoures|Karavides (crayfish)|Barbounia (red mullet)|Horiatiki|Retsina hyma
reservation: No bookings — put your name down
best_time: Early weekday lunch
notes: FLAG: no menu, no bookings, no sea view — put your name down and wait for a plastic table; Tue closed; fish by the kilo; go early at weekday lunch before the cadets; house retsina from the family's Markopoulo vines.
verdict: The most honest fried-fish lunch in Piraeus — no menu and no bookings, just a short catch of whatever the boats landed and the family's own retsina, unchanged since 1944.
caveat: Not for anyone wanting a menu, a booking, a sea view, or elbow room — it is benches, noise and a queue.
hot_this_month: Koutsomoures and barbounia are back in the fry since the trawlers returned on 1 October 2026; closed Tuesdays, so 28 Oct (a Wednesday) is open but busy (checked 14 Oct 2026).

name: Panorama
neighborhood: Kastella · Profitis Ilias hill
recognition: This Is Athens 2025 — featured; opened 1957, on-screen in 'The Burglars' (1971)
what_to_order: Grilled fish of the day|Fried seafood plates|Fresh salads|Ouzo|Greek white wine
best_time: Sunset
notes: Book a rail-side table for the view; sunset fills fast at weekends; hilltop, ~€38pp; the fish is plain, the panorama is the point.
verdict: The fish is simply grilled and the portions run large, but at ~€38pp you pay for the highest sightline in Piraeus as much as the plate — worth the Kastella climb, not a fine-dining kitchen.
caveat: Not for budget diners or anyone who won't climb Kastella — it's a hilltop, view-priced house.
hot_this_month: After the clocks go back on Sunday 25 October 2026 the view from the hill goes an hour earlier by the clock: book the view table for an earlier dinner (checked 14 Oct 2026).

name: Oinomageireio o Vasilis
neighborhood: Keratsini · inside the Ichthyoskala fish auction
tier: THE WORKING PORT — THE AUCTION & KERATSINI
recognition: Greek Gastronomy Guide 2026 — a Keratsini pick; the ichthyoskala scene profiled by Athens Voice (May 2026)
what_to_order: Marides tiganites (fried whitebait)|Htapodi sta karvouna (grilled octopus)|Garidomakaronada|Sardeles psites (grilled sardines)|Psari tis imeras|Chyma krasi
best_time: Weekday lunch off the auction
notes: FLAG: price ~€15–20pp unverified and hours irregular — phone before a visit; inside the working Keratsini fish auction, not central Piraeus; Vasilis picks the fish at the opposite dock ~03:00; walk-in only, go early for weekday lunch; refugee-run, said to feed eleven families.
verdict: The realest place to eat fish in Piraeus — the auction's own catch fried a few metres from where the boats unload, eaten among the trawlers, forklifts and refrigerated trucks.
caveat: Not for refined decor, a wine list or a romantic evening — it is a canteen at a working fish market, lunch-first, closing early; hours can be irregular.
hot_this_month: With the trawl season open since 1 October 2026 the auction is landing the deep-water fish again, so the canteen's fry has more than summer's small fish on it; lunch only, phone first (checked 14 Oct 2026).

name: To Limanaki tou Giorgou
neighborhood: Keratsini · the little harbour
address: Peloponisou & Propontidos (next to the ex-DEH power station), Keratsini 187 55
tier: THE WORKING PORT — THE AUCTION & KERATSINI
recognition: Greek Gastronomy Guide — a selected Keratsini harbour ouzeri
what_to_order: Barbounia (red mullet)|Mydia saganaki (mussels)|Keftedakia in spicy cheese sauce|Gavros tiganitos (fried anchovies)|Fish of the day|Ouzo
best_time: Quiet weekday, morning catch
notes: Book weekends or wait; under the ex-DEH power station, not a view; fish by weight, €–€€; the caïque catch runs out — go early on a weekday.
verdict: One of the few ouzeris in Attica where the backdrop is a dead power station and the fish still costs €–€€ — a genuine neighbourhood favourite, not somewhere you go for the view.
caveat: Not for anyone chasing a pretty seaside view — the backdrop is heavy industry and cranes, and weekends can mean a wait for a table.

name: To Yperokeaneion
neighborhood: Hatzikyriakio · the coastal fish-taverna strip
tier: THE BERTHS · THE OUZERI & THE MEZE
recognition: LiFO 2024 — 'the classic value of Piraeus for fish and seafood'
what_to_order: Grilled sardines on bread|Ladenia Kimolou|Grilled cuttlefish with tahini & tomato|Fried atherina (whitebait)|Mussels saganaki with garlic|Ouzo / Cretan raki
best_time: Summer evening, on the terrace
notes: Reserve — only ~8 tables plus a heated terrace; dinner only, fish-only, no meat; ~€20pp; ask for the summer terrace.
verdict: A pocket seafood ouzeri of eight tables that pulls Italians and Athenians down to Hatzikyriakio at ~€20pp — worth the reservation for the room and the fish, not for anyone in a group or after meat.
caveat: Tiny and fish-only — not for large groups, walk-ins, or meat-eaters.

name: Dyosmos
neighborhood: Freattyda · Leoforos Freattydos
recognition: LiFO 2019 — 'Greek cooking with a strong identity' in Freattyda
what_to_order: Cretan pasta with smoked pork and staka cream|Schinousa fava with Eurytania prosciutto|Mushroom sauté with Xanthi kasseri|Tzoumagia sausage with mustard & rakomelo|Aegean shrimp pasta|Tsipouro / ouzo
best_time: Evening, in the neoclassical room
notes: Book weekends; ingredient-led room, not a fry-joint; many mezedes under €15; ask what's new from the producers; near the Freattyda coast.
verdict: A meze kitchen built producer by producer, plating Cretan staka pasta and Schinousa fava in a 1920 neoclassical room with most small plates under €15 — the most identity-driven table in Freattyda, and not a sea-view fry-joint.
caveat: Not a sea-view harbour taverna nor a cheap-fry joint — it's an ingredient-led room.

name: Ikariotiko Kafeneio
neighborhood: Central Piraeus · Aristeidou St, off the port gates
recognition: Greek Gastronomy Guide — a listed Piraeus landmark kafenio
what_to_order: Fava|Loukaniko (sausage)|Dolmades|Keftedakia|Fried potatoes|Tsipouro / ouzo
best_time: Afternoon, over tavli
notes: Walk in — no bookings; relocated to Aristeidou 17 in 2023; cash, cheap tsipouro-and-meze; afternoons over tavli; smoky, no view.
verdict: Retired Ikarian sailors playing tavli, cheap tsipouro, and mezedes that arrive unbidden without a card — the most island-true kafenio near the port gates, never a dinner destination.
caveat: Not a destination dinner and no view — a smoky, no-frills community kafenio.

name: To Eidikon
neighborhood: Agios Dionysios · Psaron & Salaminos, behind the Papastrateio
recognition: LiFO 2023 — one of 'ten Piraeus shops that wrote history'
what_to_order: Cellar retsina|Patates me avga|Keftedes|Fried liver (sykoti)|Corned-beef omelette|Fava
reservation: Walk in most days; book on live-music nights
best_time: Weekday early evening, before the room fills
notes: Call to confirm the day; cash-simple; barrel retsina from the cellar below; 1938 ice-box and Occupation bullet holes on the shutters.
verdict: The last true barrel-wine oinopantopoleio in Piraeus — a 1920 room where the retsina is still pressed in the cellar directly below your table.
caveat: Not for anyone wanting a menu, a wine list or polish — five or six mezedes and barrel retsina, cash-simple, in a cramped old room.

name: Propolemikon
neighborhood: Agios Dionysios · Dervenakion St, behind the port
recognition: LiFO 2018 — one of 'ten Piraeus shops that made history'
what_to_order: Barrel wine (chyma)|Mageirefta tis imeras|Keftedes|Loukaniko|Cheese saganaki|Gigantes
best_time: A rembetiko night, late
notes: PHONE-AHEAD (substantive press is 2018); live rebetika Sat 22:00 & Sun 14:00; block-level coord; barrel wine and daily magirefta.
verdict: A stone-walled 1896 oinomageireio where the legendary Piraeus rembetiko quartet once played and the house wine still comes from cellar barrels.
caveat: Not for a quiet, refined dinner — a smoky, music-first old room; phone to confirm it is open and whether there is rembetika that night.
hot_this_month: The cold-weather music season in the stone room: rebetika Saturday from 22:00 and Sunday from 14:00 per the venue record; phone to confirm the night (checked 14 Oct 2026).

name: To Koutouki tou Antoni
neighborhood: Palaia Kokkinia · alley above Thivon St
recognition: Newsbeast 2021 — 'seven authentic koutoukia'
what_to_order: Bakaliaros skordalia|Fava|Sykoti|Keftedakia|Pancetta|Chyma krasi
best_time: A warm summer night in the courtyard
notes: Closed Mondays; weekends busiest, book ahead; courtyard around a whitewashed fig tree; cash.
verdict: A 1958 Kokkinia koutouki built around a whitewashed fig tree, where floral-cloth tables and barrel wine make dinner feel like a refugee-quarter courtyard from another century.
caveat: Not for the design-conscious or the hurried — deliberately old, tiled and floral; the joy is the courtyard, not the plating.
hot_this_month: Bakaliaros-skordalia weather under the covered fig-tree yard; closed Mondays, open Tue-Sat 12:00-24:00 and Sunday to 17:00 per the venue record (checked 14 Oct 2026).

name: Alargino
neighborhood: Nikaia · Agiou Ioannou, near the centre
tier: THE REFUGEE KITCHENS — KOKKINIA, NIKAIA & DRAPETSONA
recognition: In2life 2023 — 'the best mezedes of Nikaia'
what_to_order: Soutzoukakia Smyrnaïka|Pastourmalopita|Melitzanes gemistes|Hoirini tiganià|Saligkaria stifado
best_time: A music night, for old-Kokkinia atmosphere
notes: Call to confirm music nights; loud on weekends; owner Χατζόγλου per registry; Smyrna soutzoukakia and pastourmalopita; ~€15–20pp.
verdict: The neighbourhood table that keeps Smyrna on the plate — handmade Smyrnaïka soutzoukakia and pastourma pie under live strings.
caveat: Not a quiet or gourmet room — a loud, music-filled neighbourhood mezedopoleio, not a destination showpiece.
hot_this_month: Autumn weekends bring the live strings back indoors; book a weekend music night for the Smyrna soutzoukakia (checked 14 Oct 2026).

name: Taverna tou Katsogiannou
neighborhood: Drapetsona · opposite the church of Agios Panteleimon
tier: THE REFUGEE KITCHENS — KOKKINIA, NIKAIA & DRAPETSONA
recognition: Athinorama 2023 — critics' review, 13.5/20
what_to_order: Keftedakia me ouzo|Paidakia (lamb chops)|Smyrneiko kaiserli|Bakaliaros tiganitos|Magirefta tis imeras|Patates tiganites
best_time: Lunch, for the magirefta and meatballs
notes: Closed Mondays and Sunday evenings, lunch-focused; book weekends; the ouzo-meatball is the order; a working 1930s Prestcold fridge inside.
verdict: The oldest taverna in Drapetsona (since 1930), where Dora Stavridou's ouzo-doused meatballs in red sauce have become, in the local phrase, 'an urban myth.'
caveat: Not for a big fish spread: meat and magirefta only. Closed Mondays, Sunday lunch only.

name: Vosporos
neighborhood: Mikrolimano · Akti Koumoundourou quay
recognition: Country & Town House — chef Sophia Koletsiou eats here
what_to_order: Oversized peinirli|Politiko saganaki|Adana / sis kebab|Hunkar begendi|Pastourma & soutzouki|Bougatsa
reservation: Recommended; listings say tables are hard to get at peak times
best_time: Dinner, a night with live politika/smyrneika
notes: Phone omitted (listings conflict) — book via e-restaurants; live politika/smyrneika some nights; huge portions; Koletsiou single-source chef pick.
verdict: Piraeus's one genuine Politiki-cuisine table — Bosphorus meat-and-mezze in outsized portions, where a Piraeus chef sends you when she wants everything but fish.
caveat: Not for small appetites or fish-taverna seekers — meat- and mezze-heavy Politiki cooking in enormous portions, not Aegean seafood.

name: Toukta Thai Food
neighborhood: Nikaia · Ionias & Thrakis, the 1922 refugee grid
recognition: FlagInLife 2024 — 'an unexpected Thai experience in Nikaia'
what_to_order: Pad thai|Spicy soup (minced meat)|Thai curry|Steamed jasmine rice|Thai iced tea
best_time: Book ahead; the tiny room fills fast
notes: Book ahead — only ~6 tables; mains ~€7; mainly evenings; e-food delivery; no Greek-classics menu.
verdict: Proof Kokkinia's immigrant table didn't end in 1922 — a six-table Thai kitchen turning out the real, fresh-pounded thing at €7 a plate.
caveat: Not for the taverna-traditionalist or big groups — a cramped six-table room with no Greek-classics menu.

name: Sushi Rolls
neighborhood: Piraeus centre · behind Agios Nikolaos, near Akti Miaouli
recognition: Athens Voice 2025 — 'a diamond of Japanese cuisine in Piraeus'
what_to_order: Crispy Salmon roll|Tuna Garlic roll|Nigiri selection|Sake (cold / warm)|Asahi
best_time: Weekday evening, when the offices empty
notes: HONEST TIER — solid, not 50 Best/Michelin; small room, book; behind Agios Nikolaos; fish from Greek suppliers; coord street-level approx.
verdict: The reliable non-Greek table with a story — a shipping-office-canteen sushi bar behind the seamen's church, cut to order for the people who move ships.
caveat: Not a headline — Piraeus's real 'foreign' greatness is the refugee kitchen; this is the reliable, honest table with a story.

name: O Giorgos
neighborhood: Central Piraeus · Gounari, by the old flea market
tier: THE BERTHS · THE GRILL AND THE WRAP
recognition: in2life 2025 — #1 of Piraeus's top-five souvlaki
what_to_order: Bifteki (meatball) souvlaki|Pork kalamaki|Homemade red sauce|Pita|Tomato & onion
best_time: Weekday lunch, straight off the grill
notes: DAYTIME ONLY, closes early evening; barely any seating; the €2.50 beef-meatball wrap; expect a queue.
verdict: Piraeus's cult modern souvlaki — a ~€2.50 hand-formed beef-meatball wrap that locals and the food press repeatedly rank the city's best.
caveat: Not for a sit-down dinner — daytime only, closes early evening, seating barely there.

name: Souvlakia o Serkos
neighborhood: Kokkinia · Plateia Neraidas, behind Thivon
recognition: LiFO 2021 — 'the authentic Armenian kebab of Serkos'
what_to_order: Armenian kebab|Soutzouki (handmade)|Pastourma salad|Pork souvlaki|Pita
price_range: Kebab ~2 euros a piece; plate with two pitas, tomato, onion and tzatziki from ~9 euros (efood listing)
best_time: Early evening, when the plateia fills
notes: Phone to confirm grill hours; cash; tables out on Plateia Neraidas; salt-and-pepper mince only, the last Armenian kebab in the port.
verdict: Piraeus's last Armenian charcoal kebab — a refugee family's salt-and-pepper mince that shames every over-spiced imitation.
caveat: Not for spice-seekers or a polished dinner — a plateia grill shack, a handful of items, cash.

name: O Karabelas
neighborhood: Neo Faliro edge · Pylis, near Karaiskakis Stadium
recognition: in2life 2025 — a Piraeus top-five souvlaki
what_to_order: Gyros pita|Chicken kalamaki|Keftedaki (meatball)|House red sauce|Burger
best_time: Early evening, before the gyro sells out
notes: EVENINGS ONLY from ~18:00, closed Sunday; go before the gyro sells out; standing room; Olympiacos shrine near Karaiskakis.
verdict: The most atmospheric old-school souvlatzidiko in Piraeus — half Olympiacos museum, half standing-room grill, still turning out ~€3 wraps after nearly fifty years.
caveat: Not for a comfortable meal or the sauce-shy — a cramped, standing-room grill, evenings only.

name: Mastronikolas
neighborhood: Kastella · Karaoli & Dimitriou avenue
recognition: Cookout/SKAI 2024 — 'the historic galaktopoleio of Piraeus'
what_to_order: Galaktoboureko|Rizogalo|Krema|Kaimaki ice cream|Strained sheep's-milk yogurt
best_time: Mid-morning, a warm slice with Greek coffee
notes: Take-away sweets counter — no seating/brunch; the galaktoboureko is the order; original 1909 milk-can kept as heirloom; the Kastella original, not the Pasalimani branch.
verdict: The oldest galaktopoleio in Piraeus (since 1909), whose generous, crisp-topped galaktoboureko ranks among the best in Attica.
caveat: A sweets counter to take away from, with no savoury breakfast. A second branch operates in Pigada.

name: Euxeinon
neighborhood: Trouba · Navarchou Notara, by the port
recognition: LiFO 2022 — among the best piroski in Piraeus
what_to_order: Piroski kima (mince)|Piroski tyri (cheese)|Piroski patata|Peinirli me pastourma (Sat)|Saturday pastitsio|Greek coffee
best_time: Mid-morning, when the fryer is going
notes: Gone by midday — go mid-morning; fried, hearty, grab-and-go; Sat-only peinirli and pastitsio; phone/coord street-level approx.
verdict: The best-loved piroski in Piraeus — a half-century Pontic-refugee bakery frying cheese and mince pockets golden to order from an unbroken family recipe.
caveat: Fried, hearty and gone by midday — not for a light, sweet or late breakfast; a grab-and-go counter.

name: Bougatsa Pavlidi
neighborhood: Nikaia · Petrou Ralli, near the state hospital
recognition: LiFO 2021 — named the best bougatsa in Piraeus
what_to_order: Sweet bougatsa (γλυκιά)|Savoury bougatsa with feta|Piroski|Peinirli|Kimadopita|Tyropita
best_time: 3–6 a.m., phyllo hot off the tray
notes: OPEN 24h; no seats, no coffee — bakery counter deep in Nikaia; best 3–6 a.m. off the tray; sweet semolina bougatsa; taxi/bus from the harbour.
verdict: The last 24-hour phyllo workshop in working-class Piraeus, still turning out the port's benchmark bougatsa fresh before dawn.
caveat: Not a café — no seats, no coffee ritual, no view; a bakery counter deep in residential Nikaia, a bus or taxi from the harbour.

name: Kantina o Plastiras
neighborhood: Drapetsona · Akti Vasileiadi, Lipasmata quay (Gate E1/E2)
recognition: LiFO — chef Vasilis Kallidis's port-canteen pick
what_to_order: Pork kalamaki|Chicken kalamaki|Fresh-cut fries|Feta with oregano|Cold beer
reservation: None — plastic tables on the quay
best_time: Late, after the bouzoukia or a night ferry
notes: HOURS UNPREDICTABLE (opens early, runs after the night out); COORDS APPROX (Akti Vasileiadi quay, Gate E1/E2); cash; plastic tables; raw industrial no-man's-land.
verdict: Some of the best souvlaki in the city is grilled on a dystopian Drapetsona quay by a man who claims General Plastiras himself as his godfather.
caveat: Not for comfort, a real menu or the pretty side of Piraeus — a truckers' canteen in a raw industrial no-man's-land, hours unpredictable.
